title: HONESTY ABOUT WHAT IS OURS TO GIVE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"'If anyone dedicates to the LORD a field they have bought, which is not
part of their family land, the priest will determine its value up to the
Year of Jubilee, and the owner must pay its value on that day as
something holy to the LORD. In the Year of Jubilee the field will return
to the person from whom it was bought, the one whose land it was'"
- Lev 27:22-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
There was a difference between dedicating your own family land and
dedicating a field you had merely purchased. A bought field would return
to its original family at the Jubilee, because it was never permanently
yours to give. You could only truly dedicate to God what was actually
yours.

This is a quietly important principle. Our gifts to God must be honest.
We cannot give Him what belongs to someone else, or make a show of
generosity with what is not truly ours.

Dear friend, this speaks to the integrity of our devotion. God is not
impressed by borrowed generosity or by offerings that cost us nothing
because they were never really ours. David refused to offer God something
that cost him nothing, saying he would not sacrifice a burnt offering that
cost him nothing (2 Sam 24:24).

There is a deeper truth here too. Ultimately, everything we have was
given to us by God in the first place. When David gave generously for the
temple, he prayed, everything comes from you, and we have given you only
what comes from your hand (1 Chron 29:14).

So our giving is really the returning of what God first entrusted to us.
That should keep us both humble and honest — humble, because we own
nothing that was not first a gift; honest, because we give from what is
genuinely ours to give.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Is my giving to God honest and genuinely costly?
2. Do I remember that everything I have was first given to me by God?
3. Where might I be making a show of generosity that costs me little?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Father, everything I have first came from You. Make my giving honest and
wholehearted, and keep me humble, knowing I return only what You first
entrusted to me. Amen.
